frontmatter.name: nextjs-data-fetching
frontmatter.description: Use when reading data in a Next.js 16 App Router app — when about to call a Server Action from a Client Component to load data, when about to add a useEffect at all, when seeing useState+useEffect+fetch in a "use client" component, or when adding a `"use server"` function whose only job is to SELECT/read. Pairs with the no-use-effect skill — useEffect is never recommended here.
